title: Listening Drill — Neighbourhood tool library

sections.title: Neighbourhood tool library
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on a tool lending scheme. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with a cupboard. At the time our biggest obstacle was insurance costs. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered seasonal demand. It helped us improve stock planning. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll interview people who haven't used the scheme. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
